behaviour: Adds an optional third parameter `elements?: readonly ExcalidrawElement[]` to `reconcilePages` so local pages missing from `remotePages` are kept when non-deleted elements are still on them (AC-12).
rules: 2. sites.rule: Add optional elements?: readonly ExcalidrawElement[] parameter to reconcilePages and keep any localPage missing from remotePages that still has non-deleted elements on it.
